subject: Silverpine vendor enrollment and PO/invoice mapping
messages:
From: James Holloway <j.holloway@silverpine.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@silverpine.co>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment request — Silverpine billing details

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier today. As discussed, Silverpine would like to formalize Redwood as an approved supplier in our AP system so we can start putting POs against upcoming SOWs. A couple of things we need from your side to complete the vendor setup: 

- Completed vendor profile (legal name, remit address, VAT/Tax IDs for EU/US entities)
- W-9 or VAT certificate where applicable
- Bank remit instructions (IBAN + SWIFT or ACH details)
- Preferred invoice format (PDF + line-level XML preferred) and sample schema
- Any supplier code you want us to use when generating POs

We typically require 3-way PO matching for invoices over €5k and the PO number must be present on the invoice. Can you confirm Redwood's invoice field that will map to our PO field (e.g., "po_number" or "order_ref")? Also can you supply a small test invoice we can ingest to validate mapping?

I attached our supplier profile template and I'll send the signed W-9 in a follow-up once signed by our finance team. If we can close onboarding this week we should be able to issue the first PO on Monday.

Thanks,
James Holloway
Head of ProcureOps
Silverpine Technologies
Attachments: Silverpine_Supplier_Profile.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Holloway <j.holloway@silverpine.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment request — Silverpine billing details

Hi James — great to connect. Thanks for the clear list. Attaching our updated AP onboarding packet and an example XML invoice schema. Quick answers inline below and next steps at the end.

- Legal billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (for US invoices) / Redwood Inference Ltd. (EU billing where requested)
- VAT/Tax IDs: we'll provide VAT IDs for the EU entity once we confirm which entity Silverpine will bill.
- Bank remit instructions: attached in the AP packet (SEPA/IBAN plus USD wire).
- Invoice format: we support PDF + optional line-level XML. For automated ingestion please map Silverpine's "PO" field to our invoice header field "po_number" (we populate that from our PO acceptance flow).

Requested sample: attached Sample_Invoice_XML.xml — it includes tags for invoice header, po_number, line items (description, qty, unit_price), tax_total, and remit_currency. For 3-way matching, ensure line item descriptions map to our SKU/description field; we can provide a short mapping table if helpful.

Questions from our side:
- Which Silverpine legal entity will issue the PO? (This determines whether we attach VAT or W-9)
- Do you require net-30 or alternative payment terms?

Next steps:
1) Please return completed supplier profile + signed tax form (W-9 / VAT certificate) and bank remit details.
2) We'll create the vendor record in our systems (Marissa will own record creation, Vivek will configure PO matching rules).
3) We'll run a test invoice through your SFTP/inbound pipe.

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf, Sample_Invoice_XML.xml

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0192

Bank remit (SEPA):
IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819
BIC: NWBKGB2L
Beneficiary: Silverpine Technologies Ltd.

SFTP for testing: sftp.silverpine.co (account: redwood_test, password shared via secure channel). We'll push a test inbound file to the /inbound/tests folder once your vendor record is active. Please confirm the expected filename pattern; we will send invoice_YYYYMMDD_SILV.xml.
